breakdown.description: `ICHARG = 11` freezes the charge density even though the Step 2 note says the HSE run must recompute it and therefore `ICHARG` cannot exceed 10.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction regarding the `ICHARG` parameter. The incomplete prompt listed `ICHARG = 11` but also included a note that `ICHARG` cannot be larger than 10. Instead of correcting the value to align with the note (as the ground truth does by setting `ICHARG=0`), the agent explicitly repeated the incorrect instruction: 'Ensure ICHARG is set to 11 in the HSE INCAR'.
